title: Use a weak parent link
description: A weak_ptr refers to an object without adding a shared owner. You can use it for parent links that would otherwise form an ownership cycle.

steps.description: TreeNode owns its children through shared_ptr links. Its parent field uses weak_ptr and leaves the reference count unchanged.
The function creates a root and two children. It sets owning links downward and weak links upward.
lock attempts to obtain a shared_ptr from the weak link. The if condition checks that result before reading the parent.
The weak parent links let the shared owners release these nodes without an ownership cycle.
